name: Building and Deploying AI in Higher Education and Research Computing
description: A job-by-job course for the people who build and run AI at a university: the IAM lead scoring ChatGPT Edu, Gemini for Education, Claude for Education and Microsoft 365 Copilot terms; the HPC engineer writing Slurm GPU partitions; the RSE running a campus LLM gateway; the data steward, IRB analyst and export-control officer; and the sponsored-programs office and research-computing director. Every module is a real task with a hands-on exercise on synthetic data.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building and Deploying AI in Higher Education and Research Computing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 19 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
